extensionDescription.message: Google Drive storage provider for the VFS Toolkit.

optionsStatusText.message: Set up Google accounts and manage provider preferences.

optionsOAuthText.message: Choose the OAuth client used to sign in to Google Drive.

optionsOAuthModeBuiltinHelp.message: Use the OAuth client included with this provider.

optionsOAuthModeCustomHelp.message: Use credentials from your own Google Cloud OAuth desktop client.

optionsOAuthClientSecretHelp.message: Leave blank to keep the stored client secret.

optionsOAuthClientSecretConfigured.message: A client secret is stored. Leave this field blank to keep it.

optionsOAuthManagedNotice.message: Your administrator manages and locks this OAuth configuration. Restart Thunderbird after a policy change.

optionsOAuthChangeNotice.message: Changing the OAuth client ID requires affected accounts to sign in again. VFS connections and files remain unchanged.

optionsErrorOAuthConfigurationChanged.message: The OAuth configuration changed during sign-in. Try again.

optionsErrorOAuthConfigurationInvalid.message: The OAuth configuration is invalid or incomplete.

optionsErrorOAuthConfigurationManaged.message: This OAuth configuration is managed by your administrator and cannot be changed here.

optionsErrorOAuthPolicyInvalid.message: The administrator's OAuth policy is invalid or could not be read. Contact your administrator and restart Thunderbird after the policy is corrected.

optionsAccountsText.message: Each account is managed separately and can be used by one or more VFS connections.

optionsAccountsDataNotice.message: Signing in lets this add-on read and manage files in Google Drive. Data is transferred only for actions started by you or connected VFS add-ons.

optionsNoAccounts.message: No Google account has been set up yet.

optionsConnectionsText.message: These add-ons currently have access to a Google account through this provider.

optionsConnectionRevokeNotice.message: Revoking a connection removes only that add-on's access. It does not delete the Google account or files.

optionsConfirmRevokeConnection.message: Revoke this add-on's access to the selected Google Drive connection?

optionsConfirmDisconnect.message: Sign out of this Google account and remove it from the provider?

optionsAccountDisconnectedWithoutRevocat.message: The Google account was removed locally, but its Google access could not be revoked. Remove the access in your Google Account as well.

optionsPreferencesText.message: These settings apply to the provider. The selected export formats are used when reading Google Workspace files.

optionsErrorOAuthAccountMismatch.message: The selected Google account does not match the account being signed in again.

optionsErrorOAuthCancelled.message: Google sign-in was cancelled or not approved.

optionsErrorOAuthReauthorizationRequired.message: This Google account must be signed in again.

optionsErrorOAuthGeneric.message: Google sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.

optionsErrorUnexpected.message: The current data could not be loaded or the requested change could not be completed. Please try again.

optionsErrorAccountHasConnections.message: This Google account is still used by one or more VFS connections. Revoke those connections below before signing out.

vfsErrorAuthenticationDescription.message: Open the provider settings and sign in to this Google account again.

vfsErrorRateLimitDescription.message: Google Drive asked the provider to wait. Try again later.

vfsErrorNetworkDescription.message: Check the network connection and try again.

vfsErrorAccessDescription.message: The selected item cannot be accessed with this Google account.

vfsErrorTrashDescription.message: This Google account cannot move the selected item to the Google Drive trash.

vfsErrorMoveDescription.message: The selected item cannot be moved to this destination. Check the Google Drive permissions and restrictions.

vfsErrorCopyDescription.message: The selected item cannot be copied to this destination. Check the Google Drive permissions and restrictions.

vfsErrorUnavailableDescription.message: The selected item no longer exists or cannot be opened.

vfsSetupRequestText.message: $ADDON$ wants to use Google Drive. Choose the Google account to make available.

vfsConfigText.message: Choose the Google account and connection name used by $ADDON$.

vfsConnectionNameHelp.message: This name is shown to the connected add-on.

vfsConnectionNoAccounts.message: Add a Google account before creating this connection.

vfsConnectionErrorInvalidRequest.message: This VFS connection request is invalid or has expired.

vfsConnectionErrorNotFound.message: This VFS connection no longer exists.

vfsConnectionErrorAccountUnavailable.message: The selected Google account is unavailable or must be signed in again.

vfsConnectionErrorUnexpected.message: The VFS connection could not be saved. Please try again.
